purpose: Quality-first article development. This workflow is not a mass-production quota system.
globalRule: One excellent canonical asset is better than five adjacent posts. Drafting is blocked until demand, uniqueness and tangible buyer value are clear.

stages.pass: One reader, one urgent moment, one costly or annoying failure is concrete.
Search all published/queued/free items. Reject if an existing canonical article solves substantially the same job.
At least one defensible signal exists: first-party engagement/purchase, repeated real-world problem, or current external demand evidence. Label hypotheses as hypotheses.
Define the actual reusable asset before writing prose. Paid articles need a copyable/downloadable asset or an executable prompt/tool.
Prepare an input→output, before→after, or filled sample. No paid article ships with an empty column list alone.
Draft around the artifact; avoid house boilerplate and repeated listicle cadence.
Score >=80/100 and no component below 50% of its maximum.
Free area proves quality and clearly states what purchase adds.
Publish only one canonical page and verify reader-visible state.
Capture available 24h/72h/7d evidence; do not create adjacent variants until evidence justifies it.

hardStops: paid content without an actual reusable asset
generic listicle that could target almost any reader
article exists only to satisfy a publication quota
unsupported case study, metric, testimonial or authority claim
unknown sales/PV treated as zero or success

forbiddenPhrases: 表を増やす前に、いまのやり方で誰が何を知っていて
最初に対象を広げすぎない
一件分の記録から始める
知らないことを『未確認』と書けるようにし

publicationBoundary: New paid/free note publication remains paused until the 2026-10-16 portfolio audit has completed cleanup and a candidate passes this workflow.
